install:
mkdir -p /workspace/.mongo-data
cd /workspace/backend && python3 -m venv .venv
/workspace/backend/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r /workspace/backend/requirements.txt
cd /workspace/frontend && yarn install --frozen-lockfile
cd /workspace/frontend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL= yarn build
if [ ! -f /workspace/backend/.env ] && [ -f /workspace/backend/.env.example ]; then cp /workspace/backend/.env.example /workspace/backend/.env; fi
if [ ! -f /workspace/frontend/.env ] && [ -f /workspace/frontend/.env.example ]; then cp /workspace/frontend/.env.example /workspace/frontend/.env; fi
start:
mkdir -p /workspace/.mongo-data
if [ ! -f /workspace/backend/.env ] && [ -f /workspace/backend/.env.example ]; then cp /workspace/backend/.env.example /workspace/backend/.env; fi
if [ ! -f /workspace/frontend/.env ] && [ -f /workspace/frontend/.env.example ]; then cp /workspace/frontend/.env.example /workspace/frontend/.env; fi
if ! pgrep -x mongod >/dev/null 2>&1; then mongod --dbpath /workspace/.mongo-data --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --logpath /tmp/mongod.log --fork; fi
bash /workspace/scripts/omnia-stack.sh ensure
